description: This file defines the 'RetrieveSubjects' class, a command object for retrieving subjects from a policy based on policy ID and label in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes JSON serialization/deserialization, encapsulates policy identification, and provides utility methods for creating instances.

classes.name: RetrieveSubjects
classes.description: Final class representing a command to retrieve subjects associated with a policy, identified by policy ID and label, with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: RetrieveSubjects.of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance with PolicyId, Label, and optional headers.

methods.name: RetrieveSubjects.fromJson
methods.description: Static method to deserialize a RetrieveSubjects object from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry for which subjects are retrieved.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the policy ID associated with this command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the JSON resource related to this command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for this command, including policy ID and label.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Clones the command with new Ditto headers.
